changes.to: Built and seen on macOS Finder, iOS simulator and Android emulator; a person should look at it on their own Mac and phones

# Check the new app icon

1. **macOS**: run `scripts/build.sh`, then look at `build/Tatakikun.app` in Finder: it shows the teal icon with the white key, た and the gold star (not a generic icon). After `scripts/install.sh`, System Settings → General → Login Items shows the same icon next to Tatakikun.
2. **iOS**: run `scripts/build-ios.sh`, install the app on a simulator or iPhone; the home screen shows the icon with iOS rounded corners.
3. **Android**: install the APK (`scripts/build-android-app.sh install`); the app drawer shows the icon in the launcher's shape (circle on Pixel). With Settings → Wallpaper & style → Themed icons on, it shows the one-color key with た.
